name: hao-ai-lab/vstack
title: vstack finds 17 vLLM bugs with formal checks
summary: Hao AI Lab used vstack, an agentic formal-verification plugin, to find 17 bugs in vLLM, including silent wrong outputs, a cross-request cache mix-up, a stale LoRA adapter, and a queue leak that locks the server. Fixes for the reported cases are going upstream.

appearances.title: vstack and veriserve formally check agent-written serving code
appearances.summary: Hao AI Lab released vstack, a five-stage workflow that pins specs and checks coding-agent changes with TLC, Z3, and TLAPS before trusting them, and veriserve, a verifiable prefill-decode serving engine. The work reports three classes of RDMA and cache races in production engines and a 516,973-obligation safety proof for veriserve's KV-page lifecycle at about 0.18% mean p50 latency overhead on a GB
